acceptance_criteria.statement: Complete Pass 23 upstream E2E preflight and runtime qualification has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Live external integrations remain explicitly dry-run, mock, blocked, or unqualified unless real runtime, target, credentials, and authority were exercised.

definition_of_done: Implementation or integration evidence is present and behaviorally verified.
External live effects are never inferred from mocks, dry-runs, or adapter existence.
Integration defects are repaired in the owning subsystem rather than hidden in E2E glue.
description: Re-open the full E2E upstream cohort, record current runtime availability, and freeze live/mocked/dry-run authority boundaries before integration.
exclusions: No unverified live Jira/GitHub/cloud/provider mutation claim.
No E2E test may override canonical subsystem authority or the independent Completion Gate.
objective: Complete Pass 23 upstream E2E preflight and runtime qualification
observability_impact: Pass 23 journey stages, execution modes, expected blocks, and preserved evidence are machine-readable and traceable.
rationale: Implements the source-grounded Pass 23 full-system integration obligation while preserving explicit simulation/live boundaries.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Remove Pass 23 integration glue without changing canonical subsystem state; preserve historical evidence and prior pass artifacts.
security_impact: Preserves typed authority, least privilege, idempotency, fencing, secret boundaries, independent review, and remote-write denial by default.
title: Complete Pass 23 upstream E2E preflight and runtime qualification
